field.label: Module Enabled
field.comment: Master switch for this Magento module. This alone does not allow Walmart inventory writes.

field.label: Environment
field.comment: Select the Walmart API endpoint that matches the keys. The Magento staging website can still connect to Walmart Production for controlled read-only testing.

field.label: Walmart Client ID
field.comment: Private API credential created in the Walmart Developer Portal. Do not share it in screenshots or documents.

field.label: Walmart Client Secret
field.comment: Encrypted private API secret paired with the Client ID. Reset it in Walmart if it is exposed.

field.label: Consumer Channel Type
field.comment: Optional value provided during Walmart API onboarding.

field.label: Default Ship Node
field.comment: Leave empty to use Walmart's default ship node.

field.label: Batch Size
field.comment: Maximum number of SKU records processed in one batch. Keep 50 unless server or Walmart API testing requires a smaller value.

field.label: API Retry Count
field.comment: Number of retries for a temporary Walmart API failure. Keep 3 for normal operation.

field.label: Inventory Buffer
field.comment: Quantity subtracted from Magento stock before sending. Use 0 because Walmart option SKUs must receive the same quantity as their Magento parent.

field.label: Magento Collections Category ID
field.comment: Only enabled simple products directly assigned to this category are discovered. Current approved scope: category 273.

field.label: Unpublished Hold Start Date (UTC)
field.comment: New items are created with this future Walmart startDate and remain unpublished for review. Use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Default: 2099-12-31T00:00:00Z.

field.label: Unpublished Hold End Date (UTC)
field.comment: Must be later than the hold start date. Use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Default: 2099-12-31T23:59:59Z.

field.label: Maximum Walmart Catalog Import Age (Hours)
field.comment: Candidate discovery stops when the imported Walmart catalog is missing or older than this limit. Refresh the Walmart catalog first. Default: 24.

field.label: Allow Walmart Write Operations
field.comment: Global safety gate for every Walmart write. Inventory and item-feed writes also have their own additional controls.

field.label: Allow New Item Feed Submission
field.comment: Separate safety gate for Walmart MP_ITEM and MP_ITEM_MATCH feeds. Keep No except during an approved, hash-confirmed CLI submission.

field.label: Maximum Items Per Submitted Feed
field.comment: Hard local batch limit for new-item feeds. Start with 1 on staging and 25 or fewer in production.

field.label: Enable Automatic Catalog + Inventory Cron
field.comment: Runs the full automatic sequence: complete Walmart catalog refresh, mapping and quantity recalculation, then eligible inventory synchronization. Writes still require Allow Walmart Write Operations = Yes.

field.label: Automatic Run Cron Expression
field.comment: Five-part schedule for the complete automatic sequence. Run once daily after the Google Sheet update; do not schedule every minute.

field.label: Enable Meltable Seasonal Restriction
field.comment: Mapped Walmart SKUs for meltable Magento products are calculated as zero during the configured zero period.

field.label: Meltable Magento Categories
field.comment: Only active Magento categories are listed. Select specific meltable categories such as Chocolates, Nougats and Marzipan. Products in child categories are included automatically. Collections is a mixed merchandising category and is always ignored.

field.label: Meltable main_cat Values
field.comment: Comma- or line-separated exact values from the Magento main_cat attribute. Both main_cat and all assigned Magento categories are evaluated. Collections is always ignored.

field.label: Zero Period Starts
field.comment: Month and day in MM-DD format. Client requirement: 05-01.

field.label: Zero Period Ends
field.comment: Month and day in MM-DD format. Client requirement: 11-30.

field.label: Seasonal Rule Timezone
field.comment: Use America/New_York for the Magento store schedule.
